brand.name: Toyota
brand.tagline: Japanese carmaker; in India through Toyota Kirloskar Motor since 1997
brand.description: Japanese carmaker; sells in India through Toyota Kirloskar Motor, a joint venture formed in 1997. Cars are built at Bidadi near Bengaluru, and several models are shared with Maruti Suzuki.
